title: The Meteor Hammer Primer
summary: Teaches a complete beginner how to hold the rope and swing the weight with body strength alone.

title: First Lessons in the Corded Weight
summary: Short lessons for a student with toughened skin on pendulum swings and basic rope guards.

title: A Walker's Handbook of the Swung Head
summary: Practical handling of the weight for travellers who need to wrap and trip a pursuer using plain muscle.

title: Drill-Book of the Plain Orbit
summary: Drills the steady circling of the weight and the ways to break it out into a blow.

title: Cord and Footwork Workbook
summary: Sets out the heel and toe walk that keeps the cord clear while the weight strikes at full length.

title: Thread-Fed Meteor Canon
summary: Teaches a new qi circulator to thread a little qi along the cord while swinging.

title: Primer of the Qi-Led Swing
summary: Shows how a pulse of qi leads the weight upward and downward through a full swing.

title: Short Treatise on Catching and Recovery
summary: Covers how to catch the falling weight and turn a rebound into the next strike.

title: Workbook of the Looped Weight
summary: Practice in casting and cinching loops of cord around limbs and hilts with a little qi.

title: Handbook of Rope Guards
summary: Teaches how to turn the cord into a curtain and a parry against blades and thrown darts.
